+import importlib.util
+import os
+import unittest
+
+
+ENUM_PATH = os.path.join(
+    os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))),
+    "enum.py",
+)
+ENUM_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("enum_under_test", ENUM_PATH)
+enum_under_test = importlib.util.module_from_spec(ENUM_SPEC)
+ENUM_SPEC.loader.exec_module(enum_under_test)
+
+
+class Directions(enum_under_test.Enum):
+    UP_ONLY = frozenset({"nb"})
+    DOWN_ONLY = frozenset({"sc"})
+    DOWN_ALIAS = frozenset({"sc"})
+    MUTABLE = {"left"}
+    MUTABLE_ALIAS = {"left"}
+
+
+class EnumLookupRegressionTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_unhashable_value_finds_equal_hashable_member_value(self):
+        self.assertIs(Directions({"sc"}), Directions.DOWN_ONLY)
+
+    def test_existing_lookup_and_alias_behavior_is_preserved(self):
+        self.assertIs(Directions(frozenset({"sc"})), Directions.DOWN_ONLY)
+        self.assertIs(Directions({"left"}), Directions.MUTABLE)
+        self.assertIs(Directions.DOWN_ALIAS, Directions.DOWN_ONLY)
+        self.assertIs(Directions.MUTABLE_ALIAS, Directions.MUTABLE)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
